name: More Than Words
storyline:
The SOUL SHELL CORPORATION created androids that are virtually indistinguishable from humans. The androids were used in the world mainly as slaves. The corporation was working on a new generation of female android with superior capabilities in intelligence, strength and agility to serve the US special forces.

However, the testing phase was suspended because the slave androids started revolts in various parts of the world and consequently all types of androids were declared illegal. Now, the special forces composed mainly of cyborgs (modified humans) and robots were ordered to eliminate all androids under the law:
Androids have the right to remain silent and die
summary: More than words is a conversational game in which you can Chat with a smart, friendly, and beautiful chatbot powered by GOOGLE GEMMA 3. The chatbot remembers your past conversations. The conversations are local, so they're anonymous.
